description.description: Description of the workout; defaults to the name because Wahoo rejects plans without one (max 5000 characters)

duration.description: Duration in seconds (not for repeat blocks)

targets.description: List of targets for this interval. Only the first target is used on ELEMNT, so put power first. An empty list becomes a free RPE 1-10 target

target_type.description: Type of target: watts (absolute, recommended), percent_ftp (fraction of FTP, e.g. 0.95, converted to watts), hr, rpm, rpe, speed, ftp, map, ac, nm, threshold_hr, threshold_speed, max_hr. Unknown types are rejected.

interval_type.description: Type of interval: work, rest, warmup, cooldown, tempo, threshold, recovery, active, or any Wahoo intensity type (wu, cd, lt, map, ac, nm, ftp, recover). Unknown types are rejected.

repeat.description: Makes this a repeat block: run the nested intervals this many times in total (2-30)

intervals.description: Nested intervals of a repeat block

workout_type.description: Type of workout; sets the plan header family/location. bike = indoor bike

ftp.description: FTP in watts. Defaults to WAHOO_FTP or the FTP from the user's Wahoo power zones

external_id.description: Stable ID from the planner, e.g. pbp-2026-10-18-angels. An existing plan with this ID is replaced instead of duplicated

provider_updated_at.description: External date/time the file was updated (ISO 8601 format)
